questions.q: Tell me about an Android or Flutter app you worked on. What did it do, and what screens or features did you build yourself?
questions.looks_for: A real app with its purpose, tools used (Kotlin, Java, Flutter/Dart), their own features, and any result like Play Store release, users or ratings.

questions.q: Describe a crash or serious bug in your app that you fixed. How did you find the cause?
questions.looks_for: Uses crash reports, logs, reproducing on devices, checks lifecycle or null issues. Explains the cause, the fix, and how they confirmed it was solved.

questions.q: Users with cheap phones and slow internet say your app is slow. How would you improve it?
questions.looks_for: Profiles on low-end devices, reduces image sizes, caches data, loads in pages, shows progress or offline states, avoids heavy work on the main thread, and measures before and after.

questions.q: How do you handle the app being sent to the background or the screen rotating, so the user does not lose what they were doing?
questions.looks_for: Understands lifecycle events, saves and restores state, uses ViewModel or proper state management, and avoids memory leaks from holding old screens.

questions.q: How would you make your app work when the user has no internet for some time and then comes back online?
questions.looks_for: Stores data locally (database or cache), queues user actions, syncs when online, handles conflicts, and shows clear status to the user.

questions.q: Your new app version is live, and within an hour crash reports jump sharply. What do you do?
questions.looks_for: Checks crash reports to find the cause, halts the staged rollout if possible, informs the team, prepares a fix or turns off the feature remotely, and communicates with users if needed.

questions.q: Why do you want to work as a Android / Flutter developer, and what do you want to grow into? Please state clearly your notice period or joining date, and your expected salary in ₹ per month or per year?
questions.looks_for: Gives a genuine reason tied to the work, a sensible growth direction, a clear notice period or joining date, and a clear salary figure or range in ₹. Honest about buyout or negotiable notice if relevant.
